exams.name: Certified Fire and Explosion Investigator
exams.blurb: Certification examining origin and cause methodology from NFPA 921 for investigators of fire and explosion incidents.

exams.name: Certified Industrial Hygienist
exams.blurb: Leading industrial hygiene certification examining exposure assessment, toxicology, ventilation, noise and control strategies.

exams.name: Certified Utility Safety Professional
exams.body: Utility Safety and Ops Leadership Network (USOLN)
exams.blurb: Certification for safety professionals in electric utility work covering OSHA 1910.269, grounding, clearances and incident investigation.

exams.name: ISO 45001 Occupational Health and Safety Lead Auditor
exams.body: Exemplar Global and IRCA-Accredited Training Providers
exams.blurb: Five-day accredited course and examination qualifying auditors to lead occupational health and safety management system audits.

exams.name: NEBOSH International General Certificate in Occupational Health and Safety
exams.body: National Examination Board in Occupational Safety and Health (NEBOSH)
exams.blurb: Widely recognised entry qualification in occupational safety management, accepted by BCSP as a credential toward the CSP.

exams.name: Aerial Lift and MEWP Operator Certification
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926.453 and ANSI A92 Standards
exams.blurb: Operator qualification covering mobile elevating work platform inspection, fall protection and safe positioning under ANSI A92 standards.

exams.name: Bloodborne Pathogens Awareness Training
exams.blurb: Annual training on exposure control plans, universal precautions and post-exposure procedures required for at-risk employees.

exams.name: Excavation and Trenching Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart P
exams.blurb: Competent person training on soil classification, protective systems, access and daily inspection of excavations and trenches.

exams.name: Fall Protection Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart M
exams.blurb: Competent person training on fall hazard identification, anchorage selection, harness inspection and rescue planning at height.

exams.name: Hazard Communication and GHS Training
exams.blurb: Training on GHS labels, pictograms and safety data sheets required for every employee exposed to hazardous chemicals at work.

exams.name: Hazardous Materials Technician Level Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120(q) and NFPA 470
exams.blurb: Twenty-four hour minimum training for responders who take offensive action to plug, patch or stop a hazardous materials release.

exams.name: Hydrogen Sulfide (H2S) Awareness Training
exams.body: ANSI/ASSP Z390.1 Accepted Practices for H2S Training Programs
exams.blurb: Training for oil, gas and wastewater workers on hydrogen sulfide properties, detection, respiratory protection and rescue procedures.

exams.name: IATA Dangerous Goods Regulations Training
exams.blurb: Category-based training required every 24 months for shippers and freight staff preparing dangerous goods for carriage by air.

exams.name: IMDG Code Dangerous Goods Training
exams.blurb: Training on classification, packing, segregation and documentation for shipping dangerous goods by sea under the IMDG Code.

exams.name: Lead Awareness Training
exams.blurb: Awareness training on lead exposure routes, permissible exposure limits, hygiene facilities and medical surveillance requirements.

exams.name: Lockout/Tagout Authorized Employee Training
exams.blurb: Training for authorised employees on energy-isolating devices, machine-specific procedures and periodic inspection of energy control.

exams.name: NFPA 70E Electrical Safety in the Workplace Training
exams.blurb: Qualified person training on arc flash boundaries, incident energy analysis, PPE categories and energised work permits.

exams.name: Permit-Required Confined Space Entry Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 and 1926 Subpart AA
exams.blurb: Training for entrants, attendants and entry supervisors covering atmospheric testing, permits, ventilation and rescue arrangements.

exams.name: Powered Industrial Truck (Forklift) Operator Certification
exams.blurb: Formal instruction, practical evaluation and three-yearly re-evaluation required before an employee may operate a powered industrial truck.

exams.name: Process Safety Management Training
exams.blurb: Training on the fourteen PSM elements including process hazard analysis, mechanical integrity and management of change.

exams.name: RCRA Hazardous Waste Generator Training
exams.body: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (40 CFR Part 262)
exams.blurb: Annual training for large-quantity generator personnel on waste determination, accumulation, manifesting and contingency planning.

exams.name: Respirable Crystalline Silica Competent Person Training
exams.blurb: Competent person training on Table 1 control methods, exposure assessment and written exposure control plans for silica dust.

exams.name: Respirator Fit Test Administrator Training
exams.blurb: Training for personnel administering qualitative and quantitative respirator fit tests and managing written respiratory protection programmes.

exams.name: Scaffold Competent Person Training
exams.body: Employers under OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart L
exams.blurb: Competent person training on scaffold erection, capacity, fall protection and pre-shift inspection of supported and suspended scaffolds.
